lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour. The w39 scripts were gone, so they were rebuilt in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/799b632d-abc8-5982-a611-3a2c97f75011/scratchpad/raterB40/. m.py takes per-seat back (render y 300-400, photo 290-390), pillow (430-465 / 420-460) and pan (535-572 / 525-570) boxes on q15, the four 100 x 65 pillow-foot belt windows (y 460-525) and the far boxes on seat pixels (B-R > 22). Because the windows are re-created, absolute numbers differ slightly from w39b. Every comparison below is r39 vs r40 in the same windows. d_*.png are change masks and dmap.png is the q15 + e11 change map. The r39 to r40 diff changes 11.9 % of q15, 14.1 % of q16 and 11.4 % of q17, with a max channel delta of 11-12. The change map shows that it is entirely the fleck (yFabricD) fabric: backs E/G, the far fleck seats and the fleck pans. Changed pixels are +5.8 to +5.9 L. The lighting snapshot 0804d1c moved nothing at these cameras: the tick and lattice pans and backs are bit-identical. In the studio, e11 changes 31.4 %, e4 18.0 %, e4b 18.0 %, e7 14.9 %, e1 12.1 %, e10 10.6 % and e5 7.7 %, all on fleck surfaces. The others are under 5 %.

priorIssues.note: farA seat-pixel p90/p10 2.30 -> 2.25, L 92.0 -> 93.9, L>150 2.4 -> 2.6 %. farB 2.61 -> 2.61, L 86.0 -> 87.2 (photo farB 92.4 / 3.21 / 10.2 %). The far fleck seats moved 1-2 L lighter, which slightly reduces contrast. No geometry change: the dark row gaps and the light headrest tops are still missing.

priorIssues.note: e11: the black lip under the pan front is unchanged (the change mask covers only the fleck pan and back). The cover pixels are not in the change mask.

priorIssues.id: w39b-4 (low) navy strap V either side of the buckle
priorIssues.note: The belt-window light-grey count is 650 in both r39 and r40 (photo 1015 in these windows). The navy V is unchanged in z_low terms.

e4b changes 18 %, but only the fleck back around the pillow. Pillow L is 50.6 / 45.6 / 49.3 / 49.7 (r39 50.6 / 45.0 / 49.3 / 49.1) vs photo 72.1 / 44.6 / 45.8 / 51.1. Pillow contrast is 1.46-1.57 vs photo 2.60-5.51, because the photo's pillows show creases and corner highlights. Same plaque shape.
Pans are bit-identical: L68.6 / 68.2 / 68.1 / 64.7 vs photo 84.3 / 77.2 / 74.1 / 77.7. The 0804d1c lighting snapshot did not touch them.

q15 fleck backs: E L49.7 -> 54.7 (photo 58.9), G 53.6 -> 58.5 (photo 57.8). The mean error went from -6.7 to -1.8 L, and G is now within 1 L. Contrast p90/p10 fell from 2.97 / 3.02 to 2.77 / 2.92 (photo 3.12 / 3.61 in these windows), because the lift raised the dark ground more than the flecks. B/R is unchanged at 2.12 / 2.02 vs 2.24 / 2.10. The fleck back still reads a shade deeper than the tick, as in y_47300 (tick D/F at L89.7 / 86.4, unchanged).

issues.title: Far rows: right colour, too little contrast (carried w39b-1)
issues.evidence: farA p90/p10 2.25 (r39 2.30). farB 2.61 vs photo 3.21, L>150 6.1 % vs 10.2 %. The w40 fleck lift took 0.05 off farA.
issues.fix: In econUnitFar add a 1 cm '#1c2236' row-gap strip under each headrest cover and across the back top, and lift the far headrest-top tint toward '#5a6898'.

issues.title: Tray lip under the pan front; cover less blue (carried w39b-2)
issues.evidence: e11: the black lip is unchanged (not in the change mask). Cover B/R 1.62 vs 1.83 (w39b).
issues.fix: Tray gRBox depth 0.41 -> 0.39, set 2 cm aft, r 0.8. SEATMAT.yCover '#222842' -> '#232a4a' (shared, one line).

issues.title: Life-vest pouch opaque; strap ends at the rim (carried w39b-3)
issues.evidence: The e10 pouch pixels are unchanged from s39.

issues.title: Navy strap V either side of the buckle under every q15 pillow (carried w39b-4)
issues.evidence: 650 light-grey px in the belt windows in both rounds. The V is unchanged.
issues.fix: Strap gBox length 0.10 -> 0.06 and yaw 30 -> 15 deg, or y 0.476 -> 0.468.

issues.title: Pillow a flat plaque: shape and in-pillow contrast (carried w39b-5)
issues.evidence: Pillow p90/p10 1.46-1.57 vs photo 2.60-5.51. In y_47300 the creases and pulled-out corners make the highlight and shadow spread.
issues.fix: Pillow loft: corners out 1.5 cm, mid-edges pinched 1 cm, centre 1 cm thicker, so shading creates the crease contrast.

issues.title: Fleck contrast slightly low after the lift
issues.fix: Keep #424b68 as the mean, but raise the fleck swatch's photo gain about 10 % (lighter flecks, same ground). Optionally nudge the hue bluer to '#414b6c'. Do not darken the mean again.

issues.title: Near pans about 10-15 L dark (carried w39b-6; not scored for econ)
issues.evidence: Pans are bit-identical through 0804d1c: L64.7-68.6 vs photo 74.1-84.3.
issues.fix: Lighting owner: check the low-height fill or AO at the q15 camera. Econ should not compensate.
